First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: social pace.
Check
Look at @charlotte_critical_mass the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Charlotte Critical Mass group ride

The monthly Critical Mass ride in Uptown. Riders meet at First Ward Park on the last Friday. Charlotte Urbanists call it the city's largest group ride. The idea is safety in numbers.
